perks.summary: Crossbow bolts treat the hit body part's armor as 0 when that armor (RBM's per-part value) is below 20; armor of 20 or more is not reduced at all.
perks.conditions: Bolt hit on a body part whose armor is above 0 and below 20 (threshold reduced at sea: NavalReduced).

sites.why: Env overload on the attacker's own CharacterObject; effectValue (20) is the threshold.
Same check repeated by the War Sails wrapper (it recomputes from baseArmor).

perks.rbm: DamageRework.OverrideDamageCalc (bypass #1) still calls CalculateAdjustedArmorForBlow with RBM's armor (ArmorRework, bypass #6) and keeps the adjusted/raw ratio, so face and under-shoulder hits also drop to 0.

perks.summary: +25% ranged ready (aiming) speed while a crossbow is wielded.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the agent's character into ThrustOrRangedReadySpeedMultiplier.

perks.rbm: ThrustOrRangedReadySpeedMultiplier is only multiplied afterwards (RBMAI stamina); RBMAI's SetWeaponSkillEffectsOnAgent replacement runs before the perk step. Kept.

perks.summary: +40% damage when the troop's crossbow bolt hits a horse.
perks.conditions: Bolt hit on a mount (land only).

sites.why: Attacker's own character, consumable crossbow ammo, IsVictimAgentMount.

perks.rbm: CalculateDamage still runs on RBM's inflicted damage (bypass note 8). Kept.

perks.summary: +25% crossbow reload speed.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter into ReloadSpeed (used as-is for crossbow usages RBM does not assign).
RBM re-applies the perk as a factor on its own ReloadSpeed for crossbow/crossbow_fast usages.

perks.rbm: Bypass #8: RBM overwrites ReloadSpeed for crossbow/crossbow_fast and multiplies the perk back in (GetReloadPerkFactor).

perks.summary: -30% crossbow accuracy loss while moving (WeaponMaxMovementAccuracyPenalty x0.7).
perks.rbm: RBMAI only multiplies WeaponMaxMovementAccuracyPenalty afterwards (AgentStats.cs:159, :223, :324). Kept.

perks.summary: +50% damage on crossbow headshots.
perks.conditions: Bolt hit to the head (reduced at sea).
perks.rbm: CalculateDamage runs on RBM's damage (bypass note 8). Kept.

perks.summary: Nothing: party-leader morale and governor wage perk.
Nothing: party-leader daily XP and governor security perk.
+4 bolts in every bolt stack the troop spawns with.
perks.conditions: Troop carries crossbow ammo (any consumable whose skill is Crossbow); applied once at spawn.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the agent's character, called from Agent.Build in the mission.

Party-leader half: GetVisualPartyLeader returns the FIRST ROSTER TROOP of a party with no hero leader (bandits, caravans, villagers, garrison/militia), so a listed troop in that slot gives +2 bolts to the rest of its party (troops of its own type excluded).

perks.rbm: RBM does not patch InitializeMissionEquipment or quiver amounts at spawn.

perks.summary: Crossbow bolts treat the victim's armor as 10% lower.

sites.why: War Sails wrapper recomputes the same reduction from baseArmor.

perks.rbm: Bypass #1: the adjusted/raw armor ratio is kept, including the rebuilt face and under-shoulder armor.

perks.summary: A wielded crossbow adds no wielded-weapon encumbrance, so it no longer cuts movement speed.
perks.conditions: Only while the crossbow is wielded (not when slung); reduced at sea.

sites.why: Env overload on the agent's character; skips the 4*sqrt(length)*weight wielded-weapon term.

perks.rbm: RBM never reassigns WeaponsEncumbrance or MaxSpeedMultiplier (only stamina multiplies). Kept.

perks.summary: +50% stagger threshold while reloading a crossbow, so a blow at or under that damage does not interrupt the reload.
perks.conditions: Hit while reloading a wielded crossbow; reduced at sea. Does not cover RBM posture-break knockdowns.
perks.rbm: DecideAgentShrugOffBlow is not patched and RBM never touches BlowFlags.ShrugOff. Kept.

perks.summary: -10% damage taken from missiles while holding a crossbow in the main hand.
perks.conditions: Crossbow wielded in the main hand (not just carried); any missile, thrown weapons included; reduced at sea.

sites.why: Victim's own character, VictimMainHandWeapon is a Crossbow, consumable attacker weapon.

perks.rbm: CalculateDamage runs on RBM's damage (bypass note 8). Kept.

perks.summary: Nothing for troops: the reload-any-crossbow-on-horseback flag is only set for hero agents.
perks.rbm: Listed in TroopPerks.NoTroopEffectPerkIds (HeroOnly, RBMConfig/Shared/TroopPerks.cs). RBM's party XP replacement (bypass #20) re-invokes the party half.

perks.summary: On horseback with a crossbow: -50% movement accuracy penalty works; the -50% turning (rotational) accuracy penalty is lost because RBM AI sets that value to a fixed 0.010 for mounted shooters.
perks.conditions: Mounted, crossbow wielded. The rotational half is only lost while RBM AI is on.

sites.why: Rotational accuracy penalty (bonuses10); overwritten later by RBMAI.
WeaponRotationalAccuracyPenaltyInRadians = 0.010f when mounted with a crossbow (movement penalty only multiplied at :223).

perks.summary: Nothing for AI troops: the extra crossbow zoom is only read for the player's own agent camera.
perks.conditions: Only Mission.MainAgent's camera zoom; a regular troop is never the main agent in normal campaign play.

sites.why: Only called from Mission (MainAgent camera), Mission.cs:2299.

perks.summary: The troop's crossbow bolts can dismount riders, with +0.5 dismount penetration (ignores half the rider's dismount resistance).
perks.conditions: Bolt hit on a mounted rider that survives the hit and does not shrug it off; land only.

sites.why: One-argument GetPerkValue on the attacker's character, consumable crossbow ammo.

perks.rbm: Bypass #5 (HorseChanges DecideAgentDismountedByBlowPatch) only short-circuits non-missile couch/brace thrusts; missile hits go through vanilla DecideAgentDismountedByBlow.

perks.summary: Under RBM every non-penetrating missile that hits a shield on the back is already a block for everyone; the perk only gives a 75% chance to take no damage from missiles that pass through a non-metal shield on the back.
perks.conditions: Shield on the back hit by a missile that penetrates it (MultiplePenetration/CanPenetrateShield missiles, e.g. Impale throws); non-metal shield; reduced at sea.

sites.why: Victim's own character, env overload; effectValue (0.75) is the roll chance; called from AgentApplyDamageModel.CalculateDamage.
RBM rewrites non-penetrating back-shield hits into shield blocks, so IsDamageIgnored is moot for them.

perks.rbm: Bypass #13: back-shield hits become blocks for all agents unless the missile penetrates (metal shields stop even those), which leaves the perk only the penetrating-missile case.

perks.summary: Nothing: party-leader siege-bombardment perk and captain morale perk.
perks.rbm: Captain morale half is also lost for kills of siege defenders (bypass #17).

perks.summary: Nothing: Picked Shots is a party-leader wage and party hit-point perk.
+0.2% crossbow reload speed and +0.5% crossbow damage per point of the troop's own Crossbow skill above 200.
perks.conditions: Troop's raw Crossbow skill above 200 (few troops; captain skill bonuses do not count); reduced at sea.

sites.why: RBM re-applies the epic reload bonus after overwriting ReloadSpeed.

perks.rbm: Bypass #8: reload half re-implemented; damage half untouched.
